gloss: look of the sky; weather conditions

definitions.gloss: look of the sky; weather conditions; sky
definitions.explanation: The appearance of the sky as an indicator of the weather. Often implies uncertain or threatening weather. Also used figuratively for the 'atmosphere' or mood of a situation.

examples.japanese: {空模様|そらもよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧。
{空模様|そらもよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I looked at the sky and decided to bring an umbrella.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{空模様|そらもよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧になった。
examples.english: The sky looked bad from morning, and by afternoon it was pouring.

notes:
Literally 'sky pattern' — the appearance of the sky as a weather indicator. Often carries a nuance of uncertainty or concern about whether the weather will turn bad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空模様|そらもよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧ — the sky looks threatening
- {空模様|そらもよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ — the weather looks bad
- {空模様|そらもよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to check the sky/weather
- {空模様|そらもよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧ — to worry about the weather

USAGE:
Can be used metaphorically for the mood or atmosphere of a situation, e.g., ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空模様|そらもよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しく→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた (the atmosphere in the meeting is turning sour).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧ — weather (neutral, general)
- ⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧ — weather conditions (more formal)
- ⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧ — pattern; appearance; state of affairs
